title: A run-feed read once returned a body that is not JSON ('invalid character i'): find where a feed page can start mid-line
description: 2026-10-07 ~15:00 UTC the attached ex6 view died on 'not a run event feed: invalid character i looking for beginning of value'. #261 made the client retry such reads, but the server-side cause is unexplained; likeliest is a cursor that lands mid-line in readRunFeedPage (cloudflare/src/run-feed.ts) under concurrent appends. Reproduce with concurrent append + paged reads; make a page always start and end on a line boundary.
acceptance_criteria: a vitest reproducing concurrent appends and paged reads never returns a partial line; fix; make gate
